signal: White Cup launched White Cup CRM for distributors and acquired Sales Management Plus, expanding its purpose-built CRM footprint.

email.subject1: a signal play for White Cup
email.body1:
Scott, saw White Cup rolled out a purpose-built CRM for distributors after folding in Sales Management Plus.

A broader product line usually means more distributors in your region than the team can work before opportunities cool off, and that gap is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for White Cup off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Scott, quick follow-up for White Cup.

With the expanded CRM lineup, the addressable list of distributors grows faster than a regional team can touch. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to cover the new territory, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings White Cup needs to keep that territory covered without hiring more reps.
email.body3:
Scott, last bit of proof for White Cup.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how White Cup's reply rate likely compares to other B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Scott, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling coverage without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition and a new CRM line is its own kind of busy, and timing matters most here.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a distribution sales motion? I'll tailor it to White Cup either way.
